annotation_policy: v82 cumulative evidence audit. The v81 three-point correction is preserved. The free-throw front semicircle samples are now re-centered on the visible cyan regulation stripe in the immutable native Frame C using local curve-normal image profiles plus full-resolution visual verification. No solver residual, cross-camera transfer, player/ball evidence or generated pixels were used to place the corrected samples. All other groups and the held-out split remain unchanged.

regulation_geometry.coordinate_system: basket-local centimetres: +X from backboard face toward court, +Y across court, Z=0 floor

seed_only_correspondences.note: These four approximate lane corners initialize the nonlinear solver only; they are excluded from every residual and metric gate.

evidence_correction_v81.reason: Several v44 three-point-arc samples were visibly on adjacent timber rather than the black regulation stripe, producing a systematic same-side offset that can masquerade as lens distortion.
evidence_correction_v81.scope: three_point_arc only; all other observation groups and held-out indices unchanged
evidence_correction_v81.placement_method: Native-frame visual stripe-centre audit, cross-checked by local grayscale normal profiles. Coordinates are rounded to integer source pixels. This is a diagnostic re-annotation, not solver-derived evidence.

evidence_correction_v82.reason: After the three-point correction, the remaining pinhole held-out error was concentrated in the free-throw front semicircle. Native-frame audit showed several samples on a stripe edge rather than its centre.
evidence_correction_v82.scope: free_throw_front_semicircle only on top of v81; v81 three-point correction retained; all other observations and held-out indices unchanged
evidence_correction_v82.placement_method: For each stored sample, estimate the local curve tangent from neighboring samples, inspect a +/- normal profile around the native pixel, select the centre ridge of the thin cyan stripe, then verify all 18 points visually at enlarged native-pixel scale. This procedure was completed before the v82 solve.

notes: v82 is a cumulative annotation-error diagnostic: v44 remains untouched; v81 preserves the isolated three-point correction; v82 adds the independently audited free-throw semicircle correction. No model is promoted by this observation file.
